limitations: Source-driven and scripted emulator tests are not owner Delta playtesting or visual acceptance.
Only a charcoal kiln was donor-adapted in this increment; most Johto geography, interiors, facilities and transport need further reconstruction and verification.
The new building adds a scoped Continue relocation for saves in its footprint; future saves in that same area can also be relocated.
DS-era HGSS graphics and events require explicit GBA adaptations; no unsupported donor story or rewards were imported.
Dive, watering, decoration and VS Seeker actions were not activated in the field-action suite.
